audience: Pinterest users browsing handmade/small-batch gift ideas, natural living gifts, and stocking-stuffer or hostess-gift searches.
hook: A small-batch gift with a real story.
script: On-screen captions only, no narration (muted-first): (1) 'A small-batch gift with a real story.' (2) 'After the Harvest Tallow Soap Bar' (3) 'Made with soap scraps -- colors and flecks vary every batch' (4) 'Handmade on our Texas homestead -- Cinco H Ranch Naturals'.
static_layout: Single vertical 9:16 frame: the real After the Harvest bar centered, star emblem visible, bottom-third caption band, brand wordmark small in a corner -- used as the opening/closing slide of the video.

shots.visual: Real product photo of the After the Harvest bar, emblem in focus, caption fades in.
shots.overlay: A small-batch gift with a real story.

shots.visual: Same real product photo, slow zoom, caption names the product.
shots.overlay: After the Harvest Tallow Soap Bar

shots.visual: Same real product photo, caption states the sourced factual claim about flecks/scraps.
shots.overlay: Made with soap scraps -- colors and flecks vary every batch

shots.visual: Same real product photo, caption closes with the homestead fact and brand name.
shots.overlay: Handmade on our Texas homestead -- Cinco H Ranch Naturals

cta: Give the full story at cincohranchnaturals.com

audio.direction: Deliberately silent/caption-driven: ~85% of Pinterest viewers watch muted, so the message must not depend on sound.
